editorial_publication_readiness.summary: Do not approve revision 3. The main equity-rebound paragraph omits the specific Nvidia board-reinstatement catalyst reported by AP, leaving a key market move unexplained. Minor source-date, chart-qualification and novelty-rationale corrections are also listed below. A corrected revision 4 must preserve the canonical ID/slug, explicitly increment revision, update both locales and produce three new blob SHAs.

contrary_evidence: The PMI evidence is not a synchronized contraction: six of seven reported composite indices are above 50, while France is below 50.
The S&P 500 and Nasdaq rebounded 4.7% and 6.5% on 23 November; AP attributes a concentrated part of the move to Nvidia's 31.5% rise after the board reinstated Jensen Huang.
The IEA reports October supply growth of 2.3 mb/d to 105.4 mb/d and observed inventories rising 52 mb, which supports an oil-market rebalancing interpretation.
Brent settled 3.46% lower on 23 November, while European diesel remained 77% above pre-war levels and on-land oil inventories remained low.
Brazil's central-government primary deficit improved year over year through September and real revenue grew faster than real expenditure, tempering a one-sided fiscal deterioration thesis.
limitations: The ICE BofA OAS is a US below-investment-grade corporate-bond measure; it is not a global credit-cost index or a direct measure of private-credit pricing.
IIF's US$33.8 billion estimate is a monthly non-resident portfolio-flow measure, not total capital flight, foreign direct investment or a daily flow.

The BCB PTAX figure is correct, but reference [21] points to a dynamic official market-data page rather than a date-filtered historical query; a durable date-specific source would improve reproducibility.

The Worldsteel October crude-steel release was scheduled for 24 November but was not available by the 05:00 BRT cutoff; the report appropriately leaves it as a watch item rather than inventing October production data.
The regional PMI chart compares the euro-area aggregate with two member-country readings; these observations are comparable index values but are not additive categories.
The system-registry reconciliation has not been run for this report and remains a publication prerequisite.
